title: Invoice completed jobs
trigger: A tech closes a job in JobLog

frequency.detail: The morning after the job is closed

inputs.item: Completed job with photos, parts used and hours
Sell prices for parts and fees
inputs.source: Price List sheet in the price list spreadsheet
The property manager's work order email

outputs.destination: Emailed from the accounts inbox to the customer, or to the agency's accounts address for agency jobs

steps.action: Create an invoice for each completed job
Price each part from the Sell ex GST column of the Price List sheet, not from the price the tech entered
Add the call-out fee (after-hours call-out fee for after-hours jobs) and labour hours at the standard rate
Set the due date to 7 days after the invoice date
Email the invoice from the accounts inbox using the Xero invoice email template

decisionPoints.condition: The job is for a real estate agency
decisionPoints.action: Bill the agency, not the tenant; put the work order number in the reference and send to the agency's accounts address
Put the strata plan number in the reference

decisionPoints.condition: An emergency agency call-out has no work order yet
decisionPoints.action: Email the property manager for a work order number before sending the invoice

decisionPoints.condition: The tech hasn't entered the parts used
decisionPoints.action: Ring the tech for the parts before invoicing

qualityChecks: Every part code on the invoice appears in the Price List sheet at the same Sell ex GST price
Agency invoices show the work order number in the Reference field
The invoice shows as Sent in Xero to the customer's or agency's email address

escalation.when: An agency job's total is over the approval limit on the work order
A customer mentions a lawyer, a tribunal or a formal complaint body
A customer is unhappy with or disputes the bill
